title: Phase 9 harness artifacts uncommitted at candidate tag time in all canonical skills
description: In all three canonical skills (run.skill.md, spec.skill.md, fix_signal.skill.md), Phase 7 commits all working-tree changes. Phase 9 (Version and Tag) subsequently writes additional harness artifacts: the run file is re-written with candidate_tag set, the signal catalogue entry status is updated to 'candidate', and the signal index is updated. These files are loose (uncommitted) when the candidate tag is created, meaning the tag does not point at a commit containing the complete run artifact set. This affects every run that reaches Phase 9 across all three skills. See a1000066 for the broader fix that includes amend+retag behaviour.
proposed_resolution: Superseded in scope by a1000066 (amend+retag). The immediate fix described here (Phase 9b commit before tagging) is the minimum viable step; a1000066 adds the amend-into-previous-commit behaviour that eliminates the noise commit entirely.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000066: amend+retag commit behaviour in all canonical skills eliminates dirty-exit and separate harness commits.
